about_the_game:
A License to Legally Use Kanbello on Unlimited Business machines in a Small Business to Enterprise environment.

Also Includes the Portable Edition DLC

Unlock Portability! Use Kanbello from a USB Stick or any portable media. This DLC gives you access to a version of Kanbello with no Steam DRM. Completely DRM Free and Portable!

Features

  • DRM Free

  • Runs off of any portable media (USB Stick, Memory Cards, Portable Drives)

  • Can run from any drive location

  • Easier to use in an Office Environment

  • Legally Install and use Kanbello on unlimited Business PCs with this DLC

Once the DLC has been purchased, Start Kanbello and a new button will be available. Click the "Portable DLC" button and choose a location on your computer to save the .ZIP file. Legally copy these files to any business machine with this license.
